description: How the posts actually performed: impressions, engagement and follower numbers per connected channel, plus the top posts. Use this to answer 'how did that do', 'which platform is working' or 'what should I post more of' — it reports what iHatePosting collected from each network, not an estimate. Some platforms report nothing (they are named in `unmeasuredPlatforms`), so a zero there means 'not measurable', not 'no reach'. If a plan ever gates a range, the answer says so in a sentence with `locked: true` rather than returning silently empty numbers.

range.description: How far back to look. '12m' is a year; 'all' is everything we have recorded.
